visual_action: A montage of clips showing Donald Trump attending a professional tennis match. The video begins with the Seal of the President of the United States, then shows Trump waving from the top of an airplane staircase. It cuts to scenes from the tennis match at Arthur Ashe Stadium, including wide shots of the court, a large American flag, the silver trophy, and two male players competing. Interspersed are many shots of Trump in the audience, smiling, clapping, pumping his fist, and signing an autograph. The players are shown entering the court, playing points, and celebrating. At the end, both players are shown with their respective trophies. The video concludes with a logo for 'THE WHITE HOUSE' over a black and white image of the building.
